descriptionHint: Describe the purpose, when to call it, and the expected effect. Up to 2,000 characters.
descriptionPlaceholder: For example: synchronize a contact's paid status with the CRM after a successful subscription payment.
descriptionTooLong: The capability description must not exceed 2,000 characters.
overviewDesc: Monitor deliveries, pending work, and supplier health.
providersDesc: Register suppliers and define their request format and success rules.
connectionsDesc: Connect your business to suppliers and manage credentials.
sendDesc: Choose recipients, provide business data and a deadline, then submit.
notificationsDesc: Inspect delivery progress, failures, and attempt history.
ticketsDesc: Investigate persistent failures and record their resolution.
settingsDesc: Set your business and provider identities. Credentials stay in page memory only.
stepProvider: 1. Register a provider and publish a capability
stepSend: 3. Select targets and send a notification
emptyNotifications: Send your first notification to track it here.
registerHint: Publish at least one notification capability after registration.
previewHint: Preview builds the request without sending it.
mappingHint: Use source for fields, constant for fixed values, and values for enum mapping.
publishedHint: Published versions are immutable. New notifications use the latest published version.
noVersions: Create the first capability version below.
credentialHint: Stored encrypted. Leave empty for unauthenticated endpoints.
healthHint: Health is scoped to each connection and capability.
connectFirst: Create a connection and publish a provider capability first.
payloadHint: Provide business data. The supplier definition handles request formatting.
keyHint: Reuse the same key and content when retrying the same business notification.
expiryHint: Uses your device's time zone. Leave empty for the capability default.
acceptedHint: Persisted and queued. Acceptance does not mean the supplier has completed processing.
duplicateReceipt: Duplicate submission returned the original notification.
sendTip1: Each target has independent status and retries.
sendTip2: No new sends are started after expiration.
sendTip3: Exhausted failures enter the incident workflow.
reasonHint: At least 3 characters. The action is audited.
confirmHint: Use only after verifying acceptance in the external system.
cancelHint: Cancellation stops future sends but cannot recall an in-flight request.
retryHint: Retains the delivery ID, deadline, and attempt history.
resolveHint: Closing a ticket does not complete its deliveries. Retry, confirm, or cancel them separately.
demoSettings: This local-only demo gateway supplies configured identities. Production access requires authorized API keys.
settingsHint: Re-enter keys after refreshing. Keys are never written to browser storage.
accessRequired: Enter the relevant API key in Access settings first.
invalidJson: Invalid JSON. Check brackets and quotes.
objectRequired: The value must be a JSON object.
arrayRequired: Input fields must be a JSON array.
expiryFuture: Expiration must be in the future.
retentionTooShort: Deduplication retention must cover notification lifetime.
